title: Finite Hom support for degreewise disjoint complexes under Brown compactness
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative condensed coefficient ring. Put $S=\mathrm{Dctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $L=\mathrm{Loc}(S)$ [sk-def-localizing-closure], and assume BrownHypothesesFor $\Lambda$ $X$ [lem-sfb-brown-hypotheses-criterion]. Let $K\in L$ have underlying object in $S$. Let $M_n$, for $n\in\mathbf N$, be cochain complexes of pro-etale $\Lambda_X$-module objects such that $Q(M_n)\in L$. Suppose that in each degree $d\in\mathbf Z$ at most one term $M_n^d$ is nonzero. Then there is a finite set $T\subset\mathbf N$ such that $\operatorname{Hom}(K,Q(M_n))=0$ for every $n\notin T$. The complexes need not be bounded or constructible; their derived images only need to lie in $L$.

proof.text: Form the degreewise cochain coproduct with canonical diagonal projections. HomologicalComplex.isLimitFanMkProjOfIsColimit makes it a product since each degree has at most one nonzero term. Exact countable products of the pro-etale module category and K-injective resolutions transport this product to the derived category by DerivedCategory.isLimitFanMkQObj. DerivedCategory.isColimitCofanMkQObj transports its coproduct universal property. These are proved source-library constructions read in DegreewiseLimits.lean, Products.lean and Coproducts.lean; countableAB4Star_mod in ProperLowerStarCoproducts.lean supplies exactness.

Every localizing property containing S contains each Q(M_n) by hypothesis and their coproduct by closure. Lift the natural indexing type into the fixed ambient universe when applying this closure condition. Thus the common product-coproduct vertex belongs to L. Fullness restricts both universal properties to L; canonical projections have zero off-diagonal composites.

Apply the Brown product-coproduct finite-Hom-support theorem to these objects in L. Lower the lifted natural-number indices of its finite exceptional set. Outside that image the full-subcategory Hom type is a subsingleton. The full inclusion identifies it with the ambient Hom type in the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem BrownHypothesesFor.finite_nonzero_hom_of_degreewise_disjoint
    {Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}} (hB : BrownHypothesesFor Λ X)
    (K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory)
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K.obj ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K.obj)
    (M : ℕ → CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) ℤ)
    (hM : ∀ n, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (M n)))
    (hdisjoint : ∀ (d : ℤ) (m n : ℕ),
      ¬ IsZero ((M m).X d) → ¬ IsZero ((M n).X d) → m = n) :
    ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ n ∉ S, Subsingleton (K.obj ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (M n))
